title: Predicting Student Assignment Lateness with Interpretable Models
description: Builds a simple interpretable model from synthetic course records to flag students likely to submit late, and examines the ethical risks of using such flags and how advisers should and should not act on them.

title: Semi-Supervised Label Propagation for Scarce Medical Text Labels
description: Labels a handful of clinical-style notes by hand, spreads labels to similar unlabelled notes and measures how performance depends on label count, with checks against confidently wrong propagation.
